processing.description: Read the World Bank Indicators API response for EG.ELC.ACCS.ZS ('Access to electricity (% of population)'), WDI source 2, last updated 2026-07-13, one page holding every row (sha256 56938ff3d820…).

Kept the World and the 216 economies with a value, matched by ISO 3 code to pipeline/geo/entities.csv (the API's XKX is Kosovo, KOS; CHI is the Channel Islands, reported as one economy), from the API's country list; World Bank regions, income and lending groups were left out.
Published every non-empty value as given, 1990–2024; years without a value have no observation.

scope.basis: World Bank indicator EG.ELC.ACCS.ZS, from the SDG 7.1.1 Electrification Dataset: the percentage of the population with access to electricity, from data collected from industry, national surveys and international sources (the indicator's metadata). The world value is the World Bank's population-weighted average and starts in 1998.

title: Share of people with access to electricity
